title: Blackboard.v1
description: The durable, typed analytical STATE for one stateful-swarm task: a shared workspace where bounded workers post signals, observations, gaps, calculations, analyses and a synthesis across iterations. Teleon runs the blackboard as a runtime substrate; Baltor governs what (if anything) becomes served truth. A Blackboard is NOT truth — it is working state. tenant_scope keeps one tenant's working state isolated (never cross-tenant). status moves open -> converged (gaps closed) -> compressed (lossless distillation that preserves source handles + held-out items). entry_count and iteration are projections of the entry stream, recorded for audit.

blackboard_id.description: unique id of this blackboard (stable across iterations)

task.description: the analytical task/question this blackboard is working on

tenant_scope.description: owning tenant; working state is tenant-isolated and never crosses tenants

status.description: open = still iterating; converged = gaps closed by ConvergenceReport; compressed = losslessly distilled (source handles + held-out items preserved)

entry_count.description: number of BlackboardEntry rows posted (projection of the entry stream)

iteration.description: current iteration/round of the swarm over this blackboard
